effect: The event telling you that your trade dispute was opened said you may retaliate in 30 days; with the balance mod's IO4 change, consultations last 60 days for every dispute, the player's included, so the event now says 60. Interface text only; English and French; the other 16 languages keep the old text.

edits.find: "evt.trade.disputeOpenedFor":"Diff\xE9rend commercial ouvert avec {actor}. Vous pourrez riposter dans 30 jours si sa mesure reste en place."
edits.replace: "evt.trade.disputeOpenedFor":"Diff\xE9rend commercial ouvert avec {actor}. Vous pourrez riposter dans 60 jours si sa mesure reste en place."

edits.find: "evt.trade.disputeOpenedFor":"Trade dispute opened with {actor}. You may retaliate in 30 days if its measure stays."
edits.replace: "evt.trade.disputeOpenedFor":"Trade dispute opened with {actor}. You may retaliate in 60 days if its measure stays."
